thread:
chris: FYI customer 'tilecloud' reporting 403s from staging after we ran the rekey earlier this morning. Only traffic that goes through staging-auth-proxy fails, direct service-to-service works.
jamal: Which 403? token invalid or missing scope?
sarah: Any chance the sidecar didn't pick up the new secret?
chris: Error in proxy logs: \"auth: bearer verification failed: key not found\". Attaching minimal repro.
chris: ```bash
# from their staging env
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...OLD" https://staging-ingress.tilecloud.internal/api/health
# -> 403
```
ops-bot: automated-rotate-job: completed rekey job for tenant tilecloud at 2026-03-17T02:15:00Z :information_source:
support-oncall: Did we rotate Vault KV (versioned) or a plaintext k8s secret? That changes the reload path.
chris: Vault kv-v2. We wrote new value to secret/data/prod/tilecloud/apikey and ran the rekey job.
jamal: If Vault kv-v2 was updated, the vault-agent sidecar should GET the new version if it saw the change. Can you paste the deployment annotations and agent logs?
chris: deployment has annotation vault.hash: "abc123" still. Agent logs show: \"No changes detected for /secret/data/prod/tilecloud/apikey\" around rotate time.
sarah: That annotation should have been bumped by the rotation hook. Looks like the k8s secret sync (vault-syncer) failed to write new secret to k8s. Maybe permissions to write in staging namespace revoked by policy.
leo: Also check proxy caching: staging-auth-proxy caches JWKs/kid->key for ~5m. If the proxy cached the old kid and the token was signed with new key, you'd see kid mismatch. But logs said key not found, so proxy didn't find kid at all.
jamal: Two quick checks: (1) kubectl get secret tilecloud-apikey -n staging -o yaml -> expect new checksum; (2) curl the proxy jwks endpoint: `GET /.well-known/jwks.json` to ensure new kid present.
chris: Ran checks: `kubectl get secret tilecloud-apikey -n staging` returns lastModified: 2026-03-16T02:10:00Z (old). JWKS returns only old kid.
support-oncall: So rotation job updated Vault but vault-syncer didn't write to k8s. Likely RBAC or sidecar crash loop. Any rollout events?
chris: I see a 403 in vault-syncer logs at 02:14: `permission denied: write access to secrets staging/tilecloud`. Looks like the sync service account token was missing a policy binding.
sarah: Who applied the rotate? If it was a manual rekey, we may have missed updating the syncer's policy mapping in staging (we recently tightened access). I'll escalate to infra to add kv-v2 write for vault-syncer SA.
leo: Mitigation for customer: rotate back the Vault secret to previous value (or reissue token) so proxy and clients resume, or attach a quick patch to proxy to accept both jwks for a short window if you can push a hotfix.
jamal: While infra works the RBAC fix, you can trigger a manual `kubectl create secret` with the rotated value so proxy picks it up immediately. Make sure to record that as emergency step.
chris: Doing manual secret write now, will post result.
chris: ```bash
kubectl create secret generic tilecloud-apikey -n staging --from-literal=key=NEWVALUE --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
```
chris: Applied. Retesting...
chris: Client confirms staging calls now 200. Proxy JWKS shows new kid. :tada:
support-oncall: Good. Follow-up: add a guard so vault-syncer emits an alert on write failures, and add unit in rotate job to validate k8s secret propagation before finalizing.
sarah: Filed infra ticket INF-7832 to add RBAC check and alerting. Also scheduling postmortem with rotation playbook updates.
jamal: Add instructions to support runbook: if rotation job completes but proxy returns "key not found", check vault-syncer logs and k8s secret timestamp, then fallback to manual secret apply.
chris: Adding repro steps and timeline to ticket. Thanks team.
